passages.text: This is the burden of the word of the LORD concerning Israel. Thus declares the LORD, who stretches out the heavens and lays the foundation of the earth, who forms the spirit of man within him: “Behold, I will make Jerusalem a cup of drunkenness to all the surrounding peoples. Judah will be besieged, as well as Jerusalem.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks a message about Israel.
The LORD is the one who stretches out the heavens.
The LORD lays the foundation of the earth.
The LORD forms the spirit of man within him.
The LORD says this:
I will make Jerusalem a cup of drunkenness for all the surrounding peoples.
I will bring siege against Judah.
I will bring siege against Jerusalem.
passages.original: מַשָּׂ֥א דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֗ה נֹטֶ֤ה שָׁמַ֙יִם֙ וְיֹסֵ֣ד אָ֔רֶץ וְיֹצֵ֥ר רֽוּחַ־ אָדָ֖ם בְּקִרְבּֽוֹ׃פ הִנֵּ֣ה אָ֠נֹכִי שָׂ֣ם אֶת־ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֧ם סַף־ רַ֛עַל לְכָל־ הָעַמִּ֖ים סָבִ֑יב וְגַ֧ם עַל־ יְהוּדָ֛ה יִֽהְיֶ֥ה בַמָּצ֖וֹר עַל־ יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

passages.text: On that day, when all the nations of the earth gather against her, I will make Jerusalem a heavy stone for all the peoples; all who would heave it away will be severely injured.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks about Jerusalem.
The LORD is the one who stretches out the heavens.
The LORD lays the foundation of the earth.
The LORD forms the spirit of man within him.
The LORD says, “On that day, all the nations of the earth will gather against Jerusalem.
I will make Jerusalem a heavy stone for all the peoples.
Anyone who tries to lift that stone will be badly hurt.
All the nations of the earth will gather against Jerusalem.”
passages.original: וְהָיָ֣ה בַיּוֹם־ הַ֠הוּא אָשִׂ֨ים אֶת־ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֜ם אֶ֤בֶן מַֽעֲמָסָה֙ לְכָל־ הָ֣עַמִּ֔ים כָּל־ עֹמְסֶ֖יהָ שָׂר֣וֹט יִשָּׂרֵ֑טוּ וְנֶאֶסְפ֣וּ עָלֶ֔יהָ כֹּ֖ל גּוֹיֵ֥י הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: On that day, declares the LORD, I will strike every horse with panic, and every rider with madness. I will keep a watchful eye on the house of Judah, but I will strike with blindness all the horses of the nations.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks.
The LORD is the one who stretches out the heavens.
The LORD lays the foundation of the earth.
The LORD forms the spirit of man within him.
The LORD declares what will happen.
On that day, the LORD will act.
The LORD will strike every horse with panic.
The LORD will strike every rider with madness.
The LORD will keep a watchful eye on the house of Judah.
The LORD will strike all the horses of the nations with blindness.
passages.original: בַּיּ֨וֹם הַה֜וּא נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֗ה אַכֶּ֤ה כָל־ סוּס֙ בַּתִּמָּה֔וֹן וְרֹכְב֖וֹ בַּשִּׁגָּע֑וֹן וְעַל־ בֵּ֤ית יְהוּדָה֙ אֶפְקַ֣ח אֶת־ עֵינַ֔י וְכֹל֙ ס֣וּס הָֽעַמִּ֔ים אַכֶּ֖ה בַּֽעִוָּרֽוֹן׃

passages.text: Then the leaders of Judah will say in their hearts: ‘The people of Jerusalem are my strength, for the LORD of Hosts is their God.’
passages.sermon:
The leaders of Judah will speak in their hearts.
They will say, “The people of Jerusalem are my strength.”
The LORD of Hosts is their God.
The LORD of Hosts is powerful.
The people of Jerusalem trust in the LORD of Hosts.
The leaders of Judah find strength because the LORD of Hosts is with the people of Jerusalem.
passages.original: וְאָֽמְר֛וּ אַלֻּפֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה בְּלִבָּ֑ם אַמְצָ֥ה לִי֙ יֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם בַּיהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת אֱלֹהֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: On that day I will make the clans of Judah like a firepot in a woodpile, like a flaming torch among the sheaves; they will consume all the peoples around them on the right and on the left, while the people of Jerusalem remain secure there.
passages.sermon:
On that day, the LORD will act.
The LORD will make the clans of Judah strong.
The LORD will make them like a firepot in a woodpile.
The LORD will make them like a flaming torch among sheaves.
The clans of Judah will destroy all the peoples around them.
They will destroy people on the right and on the left.
The people of Jerusalem will remain safe.
The people of Jerusalem will stay secure in their city.
passages.original: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֡וּא אָשִׂים֩ אֶת־ אַלֻּפֵ֨י יְהוּדָ֜ה כְּֽכִיּ֧וֹר אֵ֣שׁ בְּעֵצִ֗ים וּכְלַפִּ֥יד אֵשׁ֙ בְּעָמִ֔יר וְאָ֨כְל֜וּ עַל־ יָמִ֧ין וְעַל־ שְׂמֹ֛אול אֶת־ כָּל־ הָעַמִּ֖ים סָבִ֑יב וְיָשְׁבָ֨ה יְרוּשָׁלִַ֥ם ע֛וֹד תַּחְתֶּ֖יהָ בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃פ

passages.text: The LORD will save the tents of Judah first, so that the glory of the house of David and of the people of Jerusalem may not be greater than that of Judah.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD will act to save His people.
The LORD will save the tents of Judah first.
Judah is a tribe of Israel.
The people of Judah will receive help before others.
The house of David is the royal family in Jerusalem.
The people of Jerusalem are important in Israel.
The LORD will save Judah first for a reason.
He will do this so the glory of the house of David will not be greater than the glory of Judah.
He will do this so the glory of the people of Jerusalem will not be greater than the glory of Judah.
The LORD will make sure Judah is honored equally.
No group in Israel will be lifted above Judah in glory.
passages.original: וְהוֹשִׁ֧יעַ יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־ אָהֳלֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה בָּרִֽאשֹׁנָ֑ה לְמַ֨עַן לֹֽא־ תִגְדַּ֜ל תִּפְאֶ֣רֶת בֵּית־ דָּוִ֗יד וְתִפְאֶ֛רֶת יֹשֵׁ֥ב יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם עַל־ יְהוּדָֽה׃

passages.text: On that day the LORD will defend the people of Jerusalem, so that the weakest among them will be like David, and the house of David will be like God, like the angel of the LORD going before them.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD will act on a special day.
On that day, the LORD will defend the people who live in Jerusalem.
The LORD will protect every person in Jerusalem.
The weakest person in Jerusalem will become strong like David.
David was a great and mighty king of Israel.
The house of David will become even greater.
The house of David will be like God.
The house of David will be like the angel of the LORD who goes before the people.
passages.original: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יָגֵ֤ן יְהוָה֙ בְּעַד֙ יוֹשֵׁ֣ב יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם וְהָיָ֞ה הַנִּכְשָׁ֥ל בָּהֶ֛ם בַּיּ֥וֹם הַה֖וּא כְּדָוִ֑יד וּבֵ֤ית דָּוִיד֙ כֵּֽאלֹהִ֔ים כְּמַלְאַ֥ךְ יְהוָ֖ה לִפְנֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: So on that day I will set out to destroy all the nations that come against Jerusalem.
passages.sermon: The LORD speaks.\r\nThe LORD will act on that day.\r\nThe LORD will destroy every nation that attacks Jerusalem.
passages.original: וְהָיָ֖ה בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא אֲבַקֵּ֗שׁ לְהַשְׁמִיד֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ הַגּוֹיִ֔ם הַבָּאִ֖ים עַל־ יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

passages.text: Then I will pour out on the house of David and on the people of Jerusalem a spirit of grace and prayer, and they will look on Me, the One they have pierced. They will mourn for Him as one mourns for an only child, and grieve bitterly for Him as one grieves for a firstborn son.
passages.sermon:
God will act on a special day.
God will pour out a spirit of grace and prayer.
God will give this spirit to the house of David.
God will also give this spirit to the people of Jerusalem.
The people will look at God.
They will see the One they have pierced.
They will mourn for Him.
They will mourn as people mourn for an only child.
They will grieve deeply for Him.
They will grieve as people grieve for a firstborn son.
passages.original: וְשָׁפַכְתִּי֩ עַל־ בֵּ֨ית דָּוִ֜יד וְעַ֣ל׀ יוֹשֵׁ֣ב יְרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם ר֤וּחַ חֵן֙ וְתַ֣חֲנוּנִ֔ים וְהִבִּ֥יטוּ אֵלַ֖י אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁר־ דָּקָ֑רוּ וְסָפְד֣וּ עָלָ֗יו כְּמִסְפֵּד֙ עַל־ הַיָּחִ֔יד וְהָמֵ֥ר עָלָ֖יו כְּהָמֵ֥ר עַֽל־ הַבְּכֽוֹר׃

passages.text: On that day the wailing in Jerusalem will be as great as the wailing of Hadad-rimmon in the plain of Megiddo.
passages.sermon:
On that day, people in Jerusalem will mourn.
Their mourning will be very great.
Their wailing will be as great as the wailing for Hadad-rimmon.
Hadad-rimmon was mourned in the plain of Megiddo.
passages.original: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יִגְדַּ֤ל הַמִּסְפֵּד֙ בִּיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם כְּמִסְפַּ֥ד הֲדַדְ־ רִמּ֖וֹן בְּבִקְעַ֥ת מְגִדּֽוֹן׃

passages.text: The land will mourn, each clan on its own: the clan of the house of David and their wives, the clan of the house of Nathan and their wives, the clan of the house of Levi and their wives, the clan of Shimei and their wives, and all the remaining clans and their wives.
passages.sermon:
The land will mourn.
Each family will mourn separately.
The family of the house of David will mourn by itself.
Their wives will mourn by themselves.
The family of the house of Nathan will mourn by itself.
Their wives will mourn by themselves.
The family of the house of Levi will mourn by itself.
Their wives will mourn by themselves.
The family of Shimei will mourn by itself.
Their wives will mourn by themselves.
All the remaining families will mourn separately.
Their wives will mourn by themselves.
passages.original: וְסָפְדָ֣ה הָאָ֔רֶץ מִשְׁפָּח֥וֹת מִשְׁפָּח֖וֹת לְבָ֑ד מִשְׁפַּ֨חַת בֵּית־ דָּוִ֤יד לְבָד֙ וּנְשֵׁיהֶ֣ם לְבָ֔ד מִשְׁפַּ֤חַת בֵּית־ נָתָן֙ לְבָ֔ד וּנְשֵׁיהֶ֖ם לְבָֽד׃ מִשְׁפַּ֤חַת בֵּית־ לֵוִי֙ לְבָ֔ד וּנְשֵׁיהֶ֖ם לְבָ֑ד מִשְׁפַּ֤חַת הַשִּׁמְעִי֙ לְבָ֔ד וּנְשֵׁיהֶ֖ם לְבָֽד׃ כֹּ֗ל הַמִּשְׁפָּחוֹת֙ הַנִּשְׁאָר֔וֹת מִשְׁפָּחֹ֥ת מִשְׁפָּחֹ֖ת לְבָ֑ד וּנְשֵׁיהֶ֖ם לְבָֽד׃ס
